description: This PHP source file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Dataset_Random', which extends a trivial dataset class to generate a dataset with randomly generated points for use in graph rendering or visualization. The class constructor allows specifying the number of points, range (minimum and maximum values), and whether zero should be included as an X-coordinate.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Random
classes.description: A dataset class that generates a set of points with random values for graphing purposes, primarily used for demos.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Random
methods.description: Constructor for the random dataset class, creates a specified number of points with random Y-values within given range, and includes optional zero as an X-coordinate.
